_comment: Copy to config/eval-candidates.json (not committed) and edit. Each candidate's settings are the slot's {PREFIX}_* keys without the prefix, exactly as the Config page writes them; relative paths are relative to the stack. See docs/model-evals.md.

candidates.name: qwen3.8-27b-mtplx-speed
candidates.notes: The incumbent: what llm-a runs day to day.

candidates.name: flash-next-4bit-mtplx
candidates.notes: Stock MTPLX Bare Speed pack; n-gram table on SSD, everything else resident (~78 GiB peak).

candidates.name: flash-next-3bit-g64-down4-mtplx
candidates.notes: Forged from config/forge-recipes/flash-next-3bit-g64-down4.json: expert down_proj at 4-bit (4.00 bits/weight).

candidates.name: flash-next-4bit-moestream
candidates.notes: npanj/llama.cpp expert-streaming build (dependencies.json: llama.cpp-moe-stream) with the V3 checkpoint; experts paged through a 44 GiB cache.

candidates.name: flash-next-experts3-rest8-mtplx
candidates.notes: Forged from config/forge-recipes/flash-next-experts3-rest8.json: routed experts 3-bit g64, everything else 8-bit.

candidates.name: flash-next-experts4-rest8-mtplx
candidates.notes: Forged from config/forge-recipes/flash-next-experts4-rest8.json: routed experts 4-bit g64, everything else 8-bit. The quality reference; ~+1.3% perplexity vs bf16 for this recipe per pipenetwork.

candidates.name: qwen3.8-27b-mtplx-quality
candidates.notes: 8-bit Quality pack with LLM A's current settings (8 GiB session bank, 300 s idle TTL, MTPLX defaults otherwise). Reproduces the ~100k failures.

candidates.name: qwen3.8-27b-mtplx-quality-tuned
candidates.notes: Quality pack with the memory settings from MTPLX issues #525/#567/#493: small session bank, no active pin, 2 GiB MLX cache, smaller prefill chunks.

candidates.name: qwen3.8-27b-mtplx-quality-ttl20
candidates.notes: Quality pack releasing a finished conversation after 20 s instead of 300 s, to test whether live conversations are what accumulates.

candidates.name: qwen3.8-27b-splash-q8
candidates.notes: Splash engine (brew install incoai/tap/splash), unsloth Q8_0 GGUF, bf16 KV, thinking off by default.
